deps.name: MongoDB
deps.used_for: Stores the ticket documents, their embedded comment threads, and the advisory lock rows. The system of record for everything the product remembers.

deps.name: Redis
deps.used_for: Carries the three named channels the publisher writes and the one the consumer drains.

deps.name: OpenSearch
deps.used_for: Holds a denormalised copy of each ticket's title, body and tenant so the queue can be searched. Shares its name with the compose service that runs it.

deps.name: Analytics SaaS
deps.used_for: Receives one event per plugin reaction. The client is built centrally and used by the eight plugins.

deps.name: Error reporting SaaS
deps.used_for: Receives unhandled exceptions. Its client is constructed by the factory and, in this fixture, wired to nothing else.

deployment.runs_on: A Python 3.11 container built from Dockerfile.api, started with the http entry module.
deployment.config_source: config.default.env, injected by the compose env_file directive

deployment.runs_on: The same Dockerfile.api image, started with the worker entry module instead.
deployment.config_source: config.default.env, injected by the compose env_file directive

deployment.runs_on: A node:20-alpine container running the Vite dev server. This is the ONLY environment in which the frontend is a live process; elsewhere it is a bundle baked into another image.
A single container built from Dockerfile.standalone, serving both the API and the baked frontend bundle.

observability.signal: Analytics events, one per plugin reaction
observability.where_emitted: Each plugin handler queues an event on the analytics client the factory built; the queue is in-process and flushed by the client.
observability.where_viewed: The hosted analytics product configured by ANALYTICS_URL.

observability.where_emitted: The error client the factory constructs. In this fixture nothing installs it as a handler, so nothing is actually reported — a deliberate gap.
observability.where_viewed: The hosted error tracker configured by ERRORS_URL.

config.per_env: Per environment; credentials are injected by the platform, never stored in the file.

config.purpose: Broker connection string for the pub/sub channels.
Search-index endpoint the repository re-indexes into.
config.per_env: Present in the cloud profile only.

config.purpose: Credential for the hosted analytics service.
config.per_env: SECRET — the committed file carries a placeholder; the real value is injected at deploy time.

config.purpose: How long an escalation waits before it may page.

tests.label: Authorisation gate — the composed write predicate
tests.gap: Nothing exercises the scope/tenant/state composition. Its value to the regression suite is as an ANCHOR trap, not as behaviour under test.

tests.label: Ticket repository — the upsert that makes it the system of record

tests.why: feeds the repository's write anchor and the entity's definition line into anchor-drift as an 'is stored in' claim (trap A3)

tests.gap: The repository's own behaviour is never run; only the map's claims about it are checked.

tests.label: Publisher and consumer — channel naming and the drain loop
tests.gap: No test drives a message end to end. The messaging traps are asserted against the map and the tree, not against a running broker.

tests.label: The transition use case end to end
tests.gap: No integration test walks route to store to channel.
